## About Us Section
ABOUT US

## Historical Background
HISTORICAL BACKGROUND
Life Vision Ministries LTD Was Established On 6th September 2017 And Is Incorporated In Uganda Under The Companies Act 2012. It Is A Christian Faith-Based Organisation Dedicated To Empowering Communities Spiritually And Socially.
We Spread The Message Of God Through Sunday Ministry, Healing And Deliverance Consultations, Bible Studies, And Other Church Services. Our Mission Is To Make The Word Of God Accessible To Everyone And To Promote Peace And Reconciliation In Communities And Cultures Affected By Conflict.
• Establishing Churches And Schools In Remote Villages.
• Improving Livelihoods, Providing Primary Education To Children, And Literacy To Youth And Adults.
• Supporting People Living With HIV/AIDS With Love And Care.
• Cooperating With Other Churches, Missions, And Organisations To Bring Peace To Society.
Through All This, We Aim To Spread The Gospel Of Jesus Christ And Demonstrate God's Love In Action.
"For I Preach The Gospel, That Gives Me No Ground For Boasting, Woe To Me If I Do Not Preach The Gospel" (1 Corinthians 9:16)

## Our Vision & Mission
OUR VISION & MISSION
At Vision Life Ministries, We Offer A Wide Range Of Spiritual, Social, And Community Development Services To Fulfill Our Calling And Serve God's People Effectively.

### Vision
VISION
Where There Is No Vision, The People Perish,But Whoever Obeys The Law Is Happy Proverbs 29:18.
To Expressing God's Vision Suggesting Clear Purpose And Direction Is The Essential For Thriving.
To Emphasize God's Plans For Prosperity And A Hopeful Future. Jer.29:11
Encouraging A Faith-Based Vision For The Future Preaching To God's Positivity And Hopeful Plans For Each Individual And Reflecting On God's Intention For Our Lives.

### Mission
MISSION
Our Mission Is Simply To Express Love Of God To The World And Serve With Humanity And Make Christ Known Throughout All Nations. As We Spread The Love Of Christ And Teach His Principles, It Is Our Prayer That Lives Are Transformed And Cultivated For The Work Of The Ministry For The Edifying Of The Body Of Christ. Matthew 28:19-20 KJV.
To Train, Equip, Motivate, And Empower Men And Women For Kingdom-Based Significance, And By Extension, Societal Impact. Through Image Building, Identity, Vision, And Purpose Based Ministry, To The End That The Individual Will Realize The Significance Of His Or Her Individuality, Gain A Positive Picture Of His Or Her God-Given Destiny, Resulting In Self Discovery And A Maximized Life For Kingdom Advancement

## Core Values
CORE VALUES
At Vision Life Ministries, We Offer A Wide Range Of Spiritual, Social, And Community Development Services To Fulfill Our Calling And Serve God's People Effectively.

### Abiding
ABIDING
Remaining Deeply Connected To Christ Through Prayer, Scripture, Faith, Community, And Resting In His Righteousness To Bear Lasting Spiritual Fruit. (John 15:1-17)

### Knowing
KNOWING
Growing In Biblical And Theological Knowledge That Transforms How We Live, Ensuring Our Actions Align With What We Learn. (John 8:32)

### Being
BEING
Becoming More Like Christ In Purpose, Heart, And Character, Living Self-Sacrificially And Faithfully In Every Aspect Of Life. (2 Corinthians 3:18)

### Going
GOING
Actively Sharing The Gospel And Impacting Culture With God's Redemptive Work, Spreading His Message To All Nations. (John 15:5)

## Our Objectives
OUR OBJECTIVES
At Vision Life Ministries, We Offer A Wide Range Of Spiritual, Social, And Community Development Services To Fulfill Our Calling And Serve God's People Effectively.

### Preach The Gospel
PREACH THE GOSPEL
Proclaim Jesus Christ As The Only Way Of Salvation Through Faith, Fulfilling The Great Commission.

### Evangelism & Ministry Activities
EVANGELISM & MINISTRY ACTIVITIES
Conduct Revival Meetings, Seminars, Crusades, Camps, And Rallies To Spread The Gospel.

### Church Planting
CHURCH PLANTING
Establish Churches Under The Ministry's Name In Different Localities.

### Empowerment & Talent Development
EMPOWERMENT & TALENT DEVELOPMENT
Proclaim Jesus Christ As The Only Way Of Salvation Through Faith, Fulfilling The Great Commission.

### Support For Vulnerable Groups
SUPPORT FOR VULNERABLE GROUPS
Provide Love And Care To People Living With HIV/AIDS

### Promote Christian Education
PROMOTE CHRISTIAN EDUCATION
Improve Children's Education By Opening Christian Schools, Colleges, Bible Schools, And Daycare Centres.

### Peace & Reconciliation
PEACE & RECONCILIATION
Cooperate With Churches, Missions, And Organisations To Promote Peace In The Country.

### Community Development
COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT
Build Or Support Schools, Orphanages, Hospitals, Youth And Women Development Projects, Financial Empowerment Programs, And Sponsorships.

### Fundraising & Publicity
FUNDRAISING & PUBLICITY
Organise Fundraising Activities And Promote The Ministry's Objectives Locally And Internationally.

### Property & Asset Management
PROPERTY & ASSET MANAGEMENT
Acquire, Lease, Or Purchase Property And Equipment Necessary For Ministry Activities.

### Partnerships & Grants
PARTNERSHIPS & GRANTS
Collaborate With Governments, NGOs, And Organisations To Receive Grants And Donations Supporting The Ministry's Work.

### Employment & Staffing
EMPLOYMENT & STAFFING
Hire Necessary Staff And Volunteers To Fulfill The Ministry's Objectives.
